confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are moderately reliable for a high-cost Nordic capital; accommodation is least certain given wide variation in July peak-season rates. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge of them is weaker. FX: the 15 Oct 2026 RBA rate matches across search-result summaries of rba.gov.au pages (not opened directly); a 16 Oct figure was reported but single-sourced and unverified, so it was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other high-cost Nordic capitals such as Oslo and Copenhagen for restaurant, coffee and drink levels; accommodation reflects July peak-season demand in central Reykjavik.
